law_name: Law of the Republic of Belarus No. 262-Z of 17 May 2011 on Copyright and Related Rights
term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years (extended from life + 50 years on 19 November 2024; works already in the public domain are not restored)
moral_rights: Authorship, name, integrity, disclosure & recall (no time limit)
digital_protection: Law No. 262-Z of 2011 protects technical means of protection and rights-management information (anti-circumvention and CMI provisions revised in 2011, per IIPA); article no. unverified
fair_use_exceptions: Closed list of free uses in ch. IV of Law No. 262-Z of 2011 (e.g. mass media art. 33, blind persons art. 34, libraries/archives art. 37); arts. 18-20 belonged to the repealed 1996 law
